title: Khayal After Dark: Concert & Jam
description: An evening of North Indian classical vocal music (khayal) with Anirudh Srinivasraghavan on vocals, Ehren Hanson on tabla, and Rohan Prabhudesai on harmonium, moving from an evening raga to a semi-classical ghazal selection. A free jam session for instrumentalists follows.

title: Specky Clark

description: The second program of Vika Kirchenbauer's retrospective, examining the politics of labor in contemporary art and tracing the colonial and ideological roots of 18th-century London's first public art exhibitions, with the artist in person.

description: The third film in Annie Sprinkle and Beth Stephens's ecosexual trilogy, in which an artist/activist collective examines the climate crisis and transforms grief into ecosexual art, culminating in a ceremonial Wedding to Fire; screening followed by a Q&A.

description: A program of historic and experimental animated shorts by women reflecting on diverse experiences of womanhood, guest-programmed by Rachael Guma and co-presented by WIA.

description: A program co-presented with animation collective Sunflower Lane featuring personal animated stories of reproductive health, existence, and friendship, including the new film CYCLES.

description: A series guest-programmed by Lucy Talbot Allen introducing rarely-screened avant-garde and educational films distributed by the 1960s-70s Multi-Media Resource Center, which used experimental film as sex education.

description: The new ongoing screening series pairing the movie-theater-themed photography exhibition with films about cinema-going begins with Tsai Ming-liang's Goodbye, Dragon Inn.
